issues.what: Carried w43b-L1: at grazing angles the headrest covers read lavender / navy-violet, where the photos show silver steel-blue leatherette. This is now the largest colour mismatch left in econ at thumbnail size. It is mainly the sheen: a neutral additive lobe over a navy with G-R 7 keeps G-R ~9, so the grey lifts toward lavender. The photo's grazing grey carries G-R 18 and B-G 42.
issues.evidence: q17 near cover rH (110,119,160) against y_47303 (133,151,193): G/R 1.08 vs 1.14, B/G 1.34 vs 1.28, and 25 L darker. q16 near covers rH (69,75,120) look lavender in m_q16_econAisle.jpg.
issues.fix: Shader (lighting): tint the SHEEN lobe steel-blue, ~(0.90,1.0,1.10) linear, rather than neutral, and raise its grazing gain ~20 %. Material assist (shared SEATMAT, one line): yCover '#141b44' -> '#122046' (R -2, G +5, B +2 in sRGB). This raises the base G-R from 7 to 14 so any added grey stays blue-steel, and moves head-on q15 G-R from 5 to about 9 (photo 6) at unchanged L. The material alone will not reach the photo's grazing level; the shader tint is the main fix.

issues.what: The residual cool cast on the whites and the dark pans. The armrests are +5 B-R against y_47300's -5. The seat pans are ~18 L darker than the photo.
issues.fix: Optional: seatCool 0.35 -> 0.2 in the Y zone only. Pan / seat-level fill +10 % on R and G.

issues.what: Carried: the side fabric at the frame edges smears into blotches (triplanar blend / mip). The view is ~11 L darker than y_47305 (the framing differs). The edge fabric is B/R 2.58 against the photo's defocused 1.93.
issues.evidence: m.py mean RGB rH (127,139,158) vs photo (139,150,178); fabric-mask medians.

notes: Score 8.5, the same as the final round, with a small per-view gain in q15 and q18 because the whites and fabrics no longer carry the L14 blue cast. The econ geometry and materials are byte-identical to 1430d42 and w51. The final touch landed all three L14 targets: armrest B-R +5 (target <= 6), back B/R 1.94 (target <= 2.0) and pillow B/R 2.08 (photo 2.00). It caused no regression: the only r0 -> rH change is a global 3-5 level drop in blue. Two items remain open. The medium econ item is the q17 drape-block flap, short and high and gated on question 32. The headrest-cover grazing sheen (lavender vs silver steel-blue) is open as a lighting medium with a one-line SEATMAT assist. There are no high-severity econ issues.
